title: Civil War
description: In the near future, a group of war journalists attempt to survive while reporting the truth as the United States stands on the brink of civil war.

title: Malcom X
description: A tribute to the controversial black activist and leader of the struggle for black liberation. He hit bottom during his imprisonment in the '50s, he became a Black Muslim and then a leader in the Nation of Islam. His assassination in 1965 left a legacy of self-determination and racial pride.

title: Mussolini and I
description: World War II is about to end. Benito Mussolini, il Duce, supreme dictator of Fascist Italy, sees his totalitarian dream crumbling and his power slipping away as the terrible day of his ignominious death at the hands of those he so ruthlessly oppressed for more than two decades draws inexorably near.

title: Soap Dish
description: Celeste Talbert is the star of the long-running soap opera "The Sun Also Sets." With the show's ratings down, Celeste's ruthlessly ambitious co-star, Montana Moorehead, and the show's arrogant producer, David Seton Barnes, plot to aggravate her into leaving the show by bringing back her old flame, Jeffrey Anderson, and hiring her beautiful young niece, Lori Craven.

title: Tall Tales & Legends: Annie Oakley
description: Young Phoebe Mosey (Jamie Lee Curtis) defies expectations and proves herself to become "Little Miss Sure Shot" Annie Oakley, the legendary sharpshooter and "Wild West" icon.

title: The Incredibly True Adventures of 2 Girls in Love
description: An adventurous love story between two young women of different social and economic backgrounds who find themselves going through all the typical struggles of a new romance.

title: The Kitchen Soto
description: The son of a priest slain by the Mau Mau moves in with a police officer and his wife in 1950 Kenya.
